admission_apply.text: You try the pose. The air returns sweeter, and a fraction off your own key.

native.admission_inspect: Black lacquer, thinner than breath. Near the lip it proposes a tone you have not earned.
apply_texts: Again the correction, exact to the last shine. The pose remains; the sweetness does not.
Again the same improved silence. You hear how little of the sweetness was yours.
It repeats the sweetness exactly. Exactness, in a compliment, is already cold.
One shine left, spent on making the last pose look chosen. It was only lacquer.
Set to the lip, the lacquer corrects you by a shade. The improvement is not a gift.
The gloss lends you a steadier mouth. You take the kindness, knowing the finish is not yours.
The improved silence comes again. There is little composure left for it to revise.
The reed flatters a note it will not sound. You accept the finish, and feel the cost.
The revision returns, and finds almost nothing left to improve. Precision, here, is only rude.
You try the pose. The air returns sweeter, and a fraction off your own key.
inspect_texts: A kinder outline of your lip remains in the black. Kindness this exact is not comfort.
A slender reed of black lacquer. Its gloss flatters the mouth that has not yet touched it.
Black lacquer, thinner than breath. Near the lip it proposes a tone you have not earned.
One unused shine. The reed looks more eager for that scarcity than a mouth should allow.
The gloss repeats one improved mouth. You can count the places where yours was revised.
The reed keeps yesterday's compliment. Polished things are loyal only to their own finish.
The reed's shine is steadier than your mouth. It offers that steadiness as if it were style.
The same sweetness sits in the lacquer. It has not learned you. It does not need to.
Too fine a reed for any breath. The gloss edits the lip before the lip arrives.
native.name: Compliment Reed
